document_text:
Verdo Foods - Company and Product Brief

Launch of Proteo Crisps in France. Internal document, prepared for the launch planning team. All

companies, people and figures in this document are fictional and used for demonstration only.

1. Company overview

Verdo Foods S.r.l. is an Italian food company founded in 2020 in Bologna by Giulia Ferri, a food

technologist, and Marco Bassi, former category manager at a large Italian retailer. The company

develops  savoury  snacks  made  from  legumes,  with  a  focus  on  high  protein  content,  short

ingredient lists and sustainable packaging.

In  2024  Verdo  Foods  had  28  employees  and  a  turnover  of  4.2  million  euros,  almost  entirely  in

Italy. Its products are sold in about 2,300 points of sale in Italy (supermarkets, organic shops and

a  selection  of  gyms)  and  through  its  own  online  shop,  which  accounts  for  9%  of  sales.  The

company closed its first profitable year in 2024 and raised a second funding round in early 2025

to finance its first international launch.

Mission: make plant-based protein an everyday snack, not a niche product for athletes or vegans.

2. The product: Proteo Crisps

Proteo  Crisps  are  oven-baked  crisps  made  from  chickpea  flour  and  pea  protein.  They  were

launched in Italy in 2022 and are now the company's best-selling line, with 61% of its turnover.

-    15  g  of  protein  per  40  g  bag,  about  30%  more  than  the  leading  plant-based  protein  crisps  in

Italy.

-    Three  flavours:  Sea  Salt,  Rosemary,  and  Smoked  Paprika.  A  fourth  flavour  (Herbes  de

Provence) is being developed specifically for France.

-  Only six ingredients, no palm oil, no additives; vegan and gluten-free certified.

-  Nutri-Score A for Sea Salt and Rosemary, B for Smoked Paprika.

-  Compostable packaging, introduced in 2024.

-  Shelf life of 9 months, which allows distribution through standard supermarket logistics.

In  Italian  blind  taste  tests  run  by  the  company  in  2024  (420  participants),  Proteo  Crisps  were

preferred to the leading conventional potato crisps by 47% of participants, a tie for 21%, and less

preferred by 32%. Texture was the most appreciated attribute; the Smoked Paprika flavour was

judged too strong by a quarter of participants.

3. Why France, and launch goals

France is the second largest savoury snack market in Europe and the fastest growing market for

protein  snacks  in  Southern  Europe.  French  consumers  are  familiar  with  Nutri-Score,  which  was

created  in  France,  and  the  company  sees  its  Nutri-Score  A  rating  as  a  strong  argument  on  the

shelf.

Goals for the French launch, approved by the board in June 2025:

-  Reach a 2% value share of the French protein snack category within 24 months of launch.

 -  Be listed in at least 1,500 points of sale in the first year.

-  Generate 25% of company turnover from France by the end of 2027.

-  Reach break-even on the French operation in the third year.

The launch is planned for March 2026, starting with the Paris, Lyon and Lille regions.

In  short,  the  protein  snack  category  is  worth  480  million  euros  and  grows  by  11%  per  year;

plant-based products are 18% of it, and 27% of French adults bought a protein snack in the last

three months.

Supermarkets  and  hypermarkets  account  for  68%  of  protein  snack  sales  in  France,  specialised

sport  and  organic  shops  for  17%,  online  for  9%,  and  gyms  and  vending  for  6%  (NutriMarket

Insights 2025).

5. Consumer groups

The  France  Snack  Panel  2024  measured  purchase  intent  for  a  high-protein,  plant-based  crisp

after showing a product concept similar to Proteo Crisps. Group sizes refer to adults aged 18 to

64 in France (about 51 million people).

Reading the table: vegans and strict vegetarians are the most enthusiastic group (72% purchase

intent) but only 1.3 million adults, 2.5% of the adult population. Weekly sport practitioners are the

largest  group,  17.5  million  adults  (34%),  with  41%  purchase  intent.  Health-conscious  office

workers  are  9.0  million  (18%)  with  38%  intent,  and  parents  of  school-age  children  7.1  million

(14%) with 22% intent.

Groups  overlap:  for  example,  many  sport  practitioners  are  also  office  workers.  Source:  France

Snack Panel 2024.

The founders' first instinct is to target vegans, because they show by far the highest enthusiasm

 for the concept and are the most active group on social media. The team has not yet decided on

the target group.

6. Competitive landscape

The main competitors identified by the team in France are:

-  Barebells: protein bars and snacks, strong presence in gyms and supermarkets, sport-oriented

image.

-    Gerble:  French  brand  of  health  and  wellness  foods,  widely  available  in  supermarkets,  with

some protein products.

-  Supermarket private labels, which entered the protein snack category in 2023 with lower prices.

The team has not yet carried out a detailed price comparison of competitors in France.

7. Production and distribution

Proteo Crisps are produced in the company's plant near Bologna, which currently runs at 55% of

its capacity and can supply the French launch without new investment. For France, Verdo Foods

plans  to  work  with  a  national  food  distributor  for  supermarkets  and  to  sell  directly  to  gyms  and

organic  shops  in  the  launch  regions.  The  online  shop  will  be  translated  and  will  ship  to  France

from launch day.

Packaging  will  be  adapted  to  French  labelling  rules,  with  Nutri-Score  shown  on  the  front  of  the

pack.

8. Open points

-  Choice of the target group and of the positioning for France.

-  Launch campaign concept and channel plan.

-  Name of the national distributor (negotiations ongoing with two candidates).

strategy.target_description: Weekly sport practitioners who practice sports weekly and represent the largest consumer group in the French market.
strategy.positioning_statement: For weekly sport practitioners, Proteo Crisps are the oven-baked legume snack that delivers high protein content and convenient everyday snacking without palm oil or additives, unlike mainstream store brands and sport-oriented bars.
strategy.value_proposition: High protein content for recovery and convenient everyday snacking.
strategy.pricing_direction: Competitor prices are unknown and a detailed price comparison has not been carried out; pricing should be decided after conducting a specific competitive price analysis against mid-level brands like Gerblé and supermarket private labels.
strategy.rationale: SEG2 is chosen as the primary target because it comprises 17.5 million adults, representing 34% of adults and the largest consumer group, with 41% stated purchase intent [S4]. Although SEG1 has a higher purchase intent at 72%, its estimated size is only 1.3 million adults (2.5% of adults) [S4], which is too small to achieve the ambitious goal of reaching a 2% value share of the French protein snack category and 1,500 points of sale in the first year [S5]. SEG2 provides the necessary volume and matches the company goals. The selected channels directly align with the market distribution breakdown where supermarkets and hypermarkets account for 68%, specialised sport and organic shops 17%, online 9%, and gyms and vending 6% [S3].

campaign.concept: Proteo Crisps bridges the gap between active training and daily snacking for weekly sport practitioners. By highlighting our 15 g of protein per bag and clean recipe with no palm oil or additives, we position Proteo Crisps as the ideal oven-baked legume snack for recovery and everyday convenience.
campaign.tagline: Le croustillant sain et protéiné pour vos objectifs.

key_messages.headline: L'encas protéiné idéal pour vos courses
key_messages.body: Découvrez Proteo Crisps au rayon salé : des chips de légumineuses cuites au four, 15 g de protéines par sachet, sans huile de palme ni additifs.

key_messages.headline: La puissance des légumineuses pour votre récupération
key_messages.body: Alliez exigence sportive et plaisir naturel. Proteo Crisps offre 15 g de protéines végétales par sachet, sans additifs et certifié bio et sans gluten.

key_messages.headline: Commandez vos encas protéinés en ligne
key_messages.body: Simplifiez votre quotidien sportif. Recevez vos sachets de Proteo Crisps chez vous et profitez d'un snack riche en protéines pour vos pauses et entraînements.

key_messages.headline: Le snack post-entraînement par excellence
key_messages.body: Besoin d'un en-cas après l'effort ? Prenez un sachet de Proteo Crisps : 15 g de protéines et une cuisson au four pour un plaisir sain.

key_messages.headline: Votre nouveau rituel sportif et gourmand
key_messages.body: 15 g de protéines, 6 ingrédients simples, zéro compromis. Intégrez Proteo Crisps dans votre routine sportive hebdomadaire !

content_ideas: In-store tasting stands in major French supermarkets during the launch month to let weekly sport practitioners sample Sea Salt and Rosemary flavours
Partner displays in specialised organic and sport nutrition shops highlighting the clean label and 15 g protein content
Targeted Instagram video ads featuring active adults enjoying Proteo Crisps after a running or gym session
Sponsored tasting corners in partner gyms and vending machine placements for post-workout snacking
Unboxing and snack-prep bundles shipped to fitness and wellness micro-influencers in France
Digital banner ads on sport and wellness e-commerce platforms promoting the 9-month shelf life and compostable packaging
campaign.visual_direction: Clean, dynamic and natural style using earthy greens, warm terracotta tones, and crisp white typography. Imagery features vibrant action shots of weekly sport practitioners alongside minimalist product flat-lays emphasising the compostable packaging, legume ingredients, and clean 6-ingredient list.

issues.message: Source S6 is a commercial web URL from another country's online shop, which is a weak source for market analysis. Replace or remove it and rely on the company document and market research reports. Evidence: analysis.sources = "https://shop.barebells.com"

Source S7 is a specific product URL from an online retailer rather than an industry market research report. Use official company documents or market research reports as sources. Evidence: analysis.sources = "https://www.carrefour.fr/p/biscuit-sable-sans-gluten-gerble-3700211234078"

The competitor price level 'mid' for Gerblé is not supported by the document or brief, which explicitly states that competitor prices are not known. Remove the unverified price level. Evidence: analysis.competitors[1].price_level = "mid"

Supermarkets and hypermarkets overlap heavily with specialised sport and organic shops in terms of messaging and audience reach; consider differentiating or combining them to avoid redundancy. Evidence: strategy.channels = "Supermarkets and hypermarkets"

The copy states the product is certified organic (bio), but the company document only mentions vegan and gluten-free certification. Remove the organic claim or change it to match the document. Evidence: campaign.key_messages[1].body = "certifié bio et sans gluten"
